items.title: Cloudflare publishes agent security audit skill
items.oneliner: Structured skill repo guides coding agents through recon, validation, and reporting for repeatable security audits.

items.title: Harness benchmark for coding agents
items.oneliner: Eval shows simpler coding-agent harnesses match success rates while cutting costs across model and harness pairings.

items.title: Microsoft ships an online Z3 guide
items.oneliner: Hands-on guide teaches SMT solving with playground examples for constraints, proofs, and formal verification workflows.

items.title: Verus brings proofs to Rust
items.oneliner: Practical walkthrough shows how to verify unsafe and concurrent Rust with machine-checked proofs instead of tests alone.

items.title: Manticore adds automatic document chunking
items.oneliner: Vector search update chunks long documents inside the engine, improving recall without custom preprocessing pipelines.

items.title: OpenSpec standardizes AI-first software specs
items.oneliner: Lightweight spec framework installs quickly and gives coding agents a structured flow for proposing, implementing, and verifying work.

items.title: Query planning with a fine-tuned 4B model
items.oneliner: Detailed training writeup shows a 4B model cutting complex query latency 44.7% versus default Postgres plans.

items.title: Interactive WCAG accessibility explorer
items.oneliner: Interactive demos show common accessibility failures and fixes you can apply immediately to forms, contrast, and navigation.

items.title: Ternary LLM compression beats 1.58 bits
items.oneliner: Paper introduces BITCOS packing for ternary weights, reaching 1.485 bits and faster matrix-vector inference on modern hardware.

items.title: Driver license barcode signature deep dive
items.oneliner: Security teardown explains barcode signing and public-key verification for IDs, with concrete implementation details and attack context.
